name: SaaS Genius

sources.title: Get Listed page — eligibility rules and free-listing suspension notice

requirements: Free listings are explicitly suspended: 'we aren't currently accepting free listings due to the large number of requests' — paid listing service via email
Ineligible products: mobile-only apps without a desktop component, B2C-only products, products with no US customers, software in alpha/beta
Check for an existing listing via the site search bar before requesting
preparation: Company information and social media page URLs
The category you want to be listed in (CRM, Email Marketing, Help Desk, HR, PM, Marketing Automation, etc.)
Confirmation the product is desktop-usable, B2B-compatible, has US customers, and is past beta
workflow: Search saasgenius.com to confirm the product isn't already listed
Email the published contact (on the Get Listed page) with company info + socials + desired category
Receive pricing for the listing service and pay if acceptable
Listing publishes in the chosen software category
watchFor: The 'free-listing' URL is misleading — free is suspended; everything routes to a paid listing
Eligibility rules are unusually specific (US customers required, no alpha/beta) — screen yourself before paying
Price only disclosed over email ('small and very affordable fee' is the only characterization)
Site runs a large casino/sweepstakes section — consider brand adjacency
countsAsLive: A product entry in the chosen SaaSGenius category list (e.g., /best-crm-software/) with company details
